6312.title: Desktop broker discovery across filesystem boundaries
6312.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop client requires a desktop-local broker descriptor before it can connect or request server proof; a daemon-only descriptor cannot bootstrap registration.
6312.proposedFix: Choose and security-review a supported cross-OS discovery mechanism, then verify native Windows/WSL registration, automation, restart rotation, and descriptor trust.
6312.caveats: Two clean Linux runs confirm the isolated discovery failure and copy recovery. Native Windows/WSL2, Electron UI, CDP, and navigation/capture remain unverified. The complete authored probe is embedded in the HTML; repository policy excludes standalone scripts. No safe automatic fix PR: partial reproduction and an unresolved cross-OS capability-discovery design.
